audit-history: diagnostic over which docs-audit checks ever fired; never gates, no caller outside a session debugging the audit itself
ci-check-guards-1: a CI shard of `ci-check` (D161); the workflow calls it, and a session runs `make ci-check` instead
ci-check-guards-2: a CI shard of `ci-check` (D161); the workflow calls it, and a session runs `make ci-check` instead
ci-check-static: a CI shard of `ci-check` (D161); the workflow calls it, and a session runs `make ci-check` instead
ci-check-product: a CI shard of `ci-check` (D161); the workflow calls it, and a session runs `make ci-check` instead
cid-audit: reads the whole corpus, so it is deliberately not in `make check`; cited by name in CLAUDE.md's ./pkmnscan cards audit entry
claim-ids: one-off dev tool for previewing a branch's id claims; `make merge` is what actually calls the claimer
claim-stale: one-off dev tool for checking a claimed id against a moved main; cited by name in CLAUDE.md's Hard rules
demo-histories: owner's Mac only, never CI; a one-off recording step for the demo, not a command a session reaches for
demo-mirror-rebuild: re-runs `demo-mirror` from its own gitignored snapshot; a variant of a target already documented
demo-photos: owner's Mac only; curates the tracked photograph set, not a build or verification step
down: stops what `make up` started; the pair of a documented target, not independently notable
icloud-sweep: one-off cleanup for an iCloud-synced checkout; not part of the normal build or verification path
identity-replay: one-off dev tool for replaying an identity migration against a fixture; no standing caller
lan-check: reaches the network, so it never gates a commit; a diagnostic for the owner's own LAN, not a build step
launch-config: writes `.claude/launch.json` for this checkout's own port; called by other targets, never run standalone by a session
map-fix-selftest: proves a generator that gates nothing (D18); not in `make check`, on `map-fix`'s own precedent
mutate-guards: runs every guard's mutation suite for real, ~190s; explicitly off `make check`, a manual verification step
offenders-prune-selftest: proves a generator that gates nothing (D18); not in `make check`, same precedent as `map-fix-selftest`
tests-page: writes docs/TESTS.md, the page the owner reads; `test purposes` regenerates it in memory and compares, so nothing reaches for the target except after a header edit
venv: .venv + requirements.txt; cited by name throughout CLAUDE.md's guards (VENV_GUARD) rather than reached for directly
worktree-provision-selftest: proves the worktree node_modules provisioning logic on a fixture; not in `make check`, a fresh-worktree diagnostic
